# N14 auxiliary iid sequential decision: 50th exact affine interval (author-level, unreviewed)

2026-10-23. Scope is exclusively a finite three-symbol iid auxiliary model. No native BRC/X6/Heartbeat transfer, formal Lean result, independent Driver review or first-in-literature claim.

### Model and exact claim

P=(3,1,20)/24 and Q=(2,2,20)/24; N=14. For a possibly randomized, ordered-history-dependent test that stops no later than N, define eP=P(decide Q), eQ=Q(decide P), tP=E_P(samples), tQ=E_Q(samples). Let V14(alpha)=min_{eP,eQ<=alpha} max(tP,tQ). Inherit the 49th endpoint alpha49=5171824816656394397/14900301753911083008, V49=12378473542489900069/931268859619442688, and immediate-Q probability s49=8822627424173923/13926400000000000 at B=(12,0,1). Predecessor state A49=(7,1,3) is now fixed to Q, with the previously checked first-stop tree.

THEOREM: For all real 0<=delta<=eta50=33254375/538928738205696,

    V14(alpha49+delta)=V49-(260172360/7601)*delta.

Endpoint alpha50=5171825736073354397/14900301753911083008, V50=12376506639448300069/931268859619442688. The 50th supporting line is sharp at its right endpoint, not the entire V14 function.

### Global Bellman dual

At state (n,a,b), a,b count symbols 0,1 and Q/P=2^(a+b)/3^a. Set K50=137448576/7601, lambdaQ=K50, lambdaP=72+8K50/9=122723784/7601, Gamma=260172360/7601. Under P, run the finite recursion

    D(n,a,b)=min(lambdaQ*2^(a+b)/3^a,lambdaP,1+sum_i P_i D(child_i))

with continuation omitted at n=14. Exact Fraction checking of all 680 states and 1240 non-chosen action comparisons gives 1238 strictly positive slacks and exactly two zero slacks: A50=(9,5,0) continuation/decide P and B=(12,0,1) continuation/decide Q. Root:

    Droot=9904935944811800669448959/832773482584398102528
         =V49+Gamma*alpha49.

Every possible ordered-history policy satisfies max(tP,tQ)>=tP>=Droot-lambdaP*eP-lambdaQ*eQ, proving the supporting line globally.

### Exact first-stop survival and continuation

A50 has C(9,5)=126 nominal nine-symbol histories, all 126 alive after applying ALL earlier first-stop rules at every prefix. Their exact P and Q masses are pA=4375/2359296, qA=4375/17915904. B has 12 alive histories with pB=48828125/725594112 and qB=48828125/362797056. Conditional remaining (P error,Q error,P samples,Q samples) are

    cA=(415/1327104,62047/62208,61603/55296,6461/5184);
    cB=(63/64,1/144,9/8,13/12).

Count-state sufficiency applies to iid conditional suffixes, not to unordered first-stop reach. A requires five zero symbols while B has none, so these two prefix event families are disjoint and their mixing has no interaction term.

### Every real alpha in the interval is attained

Let u be immediate-P probability at A and s be immediate-Q probability at B. Relative to the previous endpoint, error increments are A=(-X*u,+Y*u), B=(+E*(s-s49),-H*(s-s49)), where

    X=pA*cA[P-error]=1815625/3131031158784,
    Y=qA*(1-cA[Q-error])=704375/1114512556032,
    E=pB*(1-cB[P-error])=48828125/46438023168,
    H=qB*cB[Q-error]=48828125/52242776064.

With h50=(X+Y)/(E+H)=13277523/21760000000, set s=s49+h50*u. Then eP=eQ=alpha49+eta50*u, where eta50=-X+E*h50=Y-H*h50=33254375/538928738205696>0. The entire probability range is feasible, reaching s50=8831125038893923/13926400000000000 at u=1. Exact forward propagation gives tP=V49-Gamma*eta50*u. The difference tP-tQ is affine, positive at u=0 (1754761146460127401/3725075438477770752) and u=1 (1748358669994847401/3725075438477770752), so max(tP,tQ)=tP throughout. Hence the primal policy exactly matches the GLOBAL dual lower bound, for every real u.

### Sharpness of the SAME support line

Equality requires eP=eQ=alpha (both dual multipliers are positive), and no positive-mass use of any strictly positive-slack move. The only flexible states are A50 and B. Under iid probabilities, the Q/P likelihood ratio and conditional suffix law are fixed for each count state, so arbitrary ordered-history-dependent randomization at each of them reduces to an effective average u,s for both error constraints. Thus equality forces s=s49+h50*u and alpha=alpha49+eta50*u<=alpha50. Compactness of the finite randomized policy set excludes attainment of this line beyond alpha50. There is no claim that V14 stops at alpha50.

### Validation, sources, next question

Two author-side exact Fraction implementations passed: full 680-state/1240-slack Bellman/forward verifier, and a differently organized absorbing backward/four-corner program enumerating all 3^9=19683 ordered nine-letter histories, with 126 live A prefixes and zero mixed corner term. This is not independent Research Driver review or Lean formal verification.

Next dual candidate ONLY: K51=3779136/217, A51=(10,4,4), continue/decide-Q tie. Its first-reach masses, primal balancing, endpoint and sharpness remain unproved.
